title: Repair reviewed V2 client usability blockers
goal: Apply the three TASK-042 findings to the integrated V2 client without changing approved APIs DOM or scope
acceptance_criteria: A plan with at least one drafted test item submits without stale native required-field blocking while an empty draft set remains blocked
Opening plan detail from workbench presents a visible 420px plan drawer and closing restores the originating V2 view and focus
An arrived untested plan has no visible main-status label while preserving screen-reader text and statistical exclusion
All node 26+ tests isolated desktop browser and Release checks pass

release_controls.execution_window: current approved V2 repair session after TASK-042 changes-required review
release_controls.rollback_plan: revert the small public/app.js repair commit; keep prior integrated implementation and evidence
release_controls.observation_metrics: three exact browser regressions dual viewport metrics V1 behavior 26+ tests reviewer evidence
release_controls.stop_conditions: scope drift contract change unresolved finding failing browser flow or regression
